messages:
Maya (People Ops): starting a short follow-up thread from today’s all-hands on reviews/leveling/promos. toss quick Qs or items that need clarification and well answer here.
Chris (Senior IC): quick one 1: if promotion approval lands mid-week, when does comp update?
Maya (People Ops): standard is effective at the start of the next pay period after approval. retro pay can be done in select cases, usually back to the approval date. DM @Jenna to request retro review.
Raj (Engineering Manager): question on the new packet template: minimum fields to submit?
Jenna (People Ops): minimal required: 1) 3-bullet impact summary, 2) evidence of scope/ownership change, 3) manager calibration note. optional: stakeholder feedback, project metrics. template: https://intranet.redwood/peopleops/promo-packet
Lina (VP Eng): add to that: include 1 measurable outcome if possible. calibration panels favor concrete signals over subjective language.
Chris (Senior IC): is there a path for ICs to self-initiate exceptions or is manager gatekeeping required?
Maya (People Ops): exceptions need manager sponsorship. staff can prepare materials and request manager submission. well triage on a rolling basis; target initial response within 10 business days.
Anya (Recruiting): hiring related 1: if someone joins during the promo window are they in-scope for that cycle?
Jenna (People Ops): new hires eligible after 6 months by default. exceptions are rare and require People Ops + hiring manager approval. offers should not promise immediate promo.
Tom (CEO): reminder: promotions should reflect role clarity & scope. if a case looks like it changes org structure, loop in me or Lina early.
Raj (Engineering Manager): benefits: any changes to 401k match schedule this year? team asking.
Maya (People Ops): no changes for this cycle. if we plan changes well give at least 60 days notice.
Chris (Senior IC): parental leave follow-up: birth vs adoption durations?
Jenna (People Ops): primary caregiver (birth) = 16 weeks paid; secondary/adoption = 12 weeks paid. see benefits portal for full details.
Maya (People Ops): promo timeline recap from the all-hands:
- Nominations open: 2026-04-01
- Manager packet deadline: 2026-04-21
- Calibration panels: 2026-04-28 to 2026-05-05
- Notifications: by 2026-05-12
Maya (People Ops): managers: small checklist we recommended at the meeting: 1) update role doc, 2) gather 2-3 concrete examples, 3) submit packet with manager note, 4) suggest comp band.
Chris (Senior IC): will salary bands be published this quarter? would help when proposing comp.
Maya (People Ops): band refresh scheduled for next week; will post to handbook and share link here once live.
Raj (Engineering Manager): can we get an office-hours slot to run through tricky promo cases?
Lina (VP Eng): happy to join a 30-min slot right after calibration opens.
Maya (People Ops): scheduling manager office hours: 2026-04-22 16:00 PST. invite coming.
hr-bot: Reminder: review process doc updated  https://intranet.redwood/peopleops/review-process (auto).
Maya (People Ops): thanks everyone. if you have private comp or eligibility questions DM me or @Jenna. well collect outstanding asks here and pin a short FAQ once band numbers and the template link are live. :memo:
